rows.desc: 卡通加农炮 3D 模型（GLB）· 程序化生成 · 半透明玻璃炮管+黄铜装饰箍+青铜侧轮+青铜金属底座（底座与车轮同材质）。接线约定：前向轴=+Z（炮口沿 local +Z 出膛）；原点=底座中心/旋转支点（底面/轮胎落 y=0）；muzzle(炮口)local=[0, 1.102, 1.013]（炮管已整体上抬 0.30 脱离底座）；命名节点 carriage/barrel/barrel_trim/wheel_l/wheel_r。barrel 为半透明玻璃（alphaMode=BLEND·alpha=0.45·淡青玻璃色·挂 KHR_materials_transmission 0.85+ior 1.5），非中性色，若仍要 tint 需注意乘法后偏玻璃底色。

provenance.method: procedural-glTF (cylinderZ/torusZ + trapezoid carriage + side wheels, per-part PBR baseColorFactor+metallicFactor+roughnessFactor; glass barrel via alphaMode BLEND + KHR_materials_transmission/KHR_materials_ior; zero external assets/network)
provenance.origin: base center / rotation pivot; sits on y=0 (wheels+carriage ground)
provenance.materials: barrel=translucent glass, pale cyan #B8DBE6 (metal=0, rough=0.06, alphaMode=BLEND alpha=0.45 + KHR_materials_transmission 0.85 + ior 1.5), lifted +0.30 in Y to clear the carriage; barrel_trim=brass #E7C27D (metal=1, rough=0.22, fixed gold rings, opaque, lifted with barrel); wheels=bronze #B87333 (metal=1, rough=0.35); carriage=bronze #B87333 (metal=1, rough=0.35, same material as wheels)
provenance.tintTarget: barrel is now translucent glass (colored, alpha-blended) — tint no longer reads as neutral; barrel_trim/wheels/carriage fixed
provenance.scaleNote: scale 34 → 约 1.6 体素长(z·1.615*34≈55, PITCH=33)/~1.2 体素高；1.5~2 体素区间可用 31~41，restingTiltX=-0.12rad 上扬姿态
provenance.note: deterministic; CC0 (纯我方程序化几何·无外部素材·无网络)
